intent: A dark, monochrome settings card driven by a sections prop: rows stagger in, switches fill once they land, sections cross-fade while the card eases to height, and a save bar counts unsaved changes.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with @container queries; colour tokens as CSS variables on the root
stack.animation: motion/react: motion values and useTransform for counting figures and path geometry (no per-frame React setState), layoutId for selection, AnimatePresence for swaps
stack.fonts: font-display (Geist) for headlines, font-sans (Geist) with tnum, font-mono (Geist Mono) for small labels

layout.card: surface, 1px line, 16px radius, inset highlight + deep shadow, overflow hidden, @container root
layout.header: title, description, section tabs with travelling underline and unsaved dots
layout.rows: switch inline at every width; segmented hugs right from @lg; select/text fill a 1fr/1.15fr column from @lg, stacked below
layout.saveBar: foot of the card: count, Discard, Save (fixed min width, ⌘S kbd from @md)

color.approach: greyscale; one accent prop (default theme ink) for switches that are on and Save; segmented selection is an ink pill; focus rings are ink

motion.order: card → title → description → tabs (60ms apart) → rows from 0.22s, 50ms apart → each control settles 0.16s after its row
motion.switch: accent layer fades in, knob slides on spring 500/40
motion.segmented: pill lands with opacity + 0.92 scale, then travels by layoutId
motion.sectionSwitch: rows exit together (6px up, 4px blur, 0.16s); next rows 40ms apart; card height eases over 0.32s
motion.saveBar: height 0 → auto (0.34s); message cross-fades; saving spinner in the same box; 'Changes saved' lingers 1.8s then collapses
motion.reducedMotion: 150ms fades, controls instant, no height animation

responsive.390: fields and segmented controls full width under their labels; switches stay inline

accessibility: role=switch with aria-checked, labelled and described by the row
segmented radiogroups with roving tabindex and arrow keys
real labels and native selects; color-scheme follows theme

content.sections: Notifications (Mentions, Replies, Weekly digest, Product news, Delivery), Appearance (Theme, Density, Week starts on, Calm mode), Profile (Display name, Username with prefix, Time zone)

avoid: lime or brand colour on focus rings and nav
a full page with header and side nav
